text: Code reviews are an essential part of software development. Their main purpose is to catch bugs early, before the code reaches users. When another developer checks your changes, they often spot problems you missed, saving time and effort later. However, code reviews are not just about finding errors. They are also a valuable opportunity for knowledge sharing. Team members can learn about different parts of the codebase and discover new techniques. This process helps ensure a consistent level of team quality, as coding standards and best practices are maintained. Ultimately, code reviews build stronger, more collaborative teams.
